yourNature_desc: You are the jewel after refinement, small and exact, with more light than its size allows. You run even, with Metal coming in as fast as you spend it. Since nothing pushes you past good enough, you need your own reason to call a piece finished. You weigh stopping where it works against going on toward your best. You hold a gift in that freedom, and you pay for it in the deciding.

self_card.face: Polished, and set where it shows
self_card.presence: You run steady, and your full care goes where you choose rather than everywhere. You make that choice all day, and each one costs a little of your ease.
